title: Which club will Ollie Watkins join during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Ollie Watkins is an Aston Villa striker.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official club announcements or confirmed reporting from a major sports news organization establishing Watkins's completed transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the destination club in the completed transfer. Transfer speculation or an unaccepted offer does not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the destination club.
